notes: Curated MCP server registry shipped by vinOS. Each entry defines a portable server definition consumable by any MCP-capable runner (Claude Code, Codex, Aider, etc). vinos-mcp adds/removes entries into ~/.config/vinos/mcp/servers.json which each runner's adapter syncs into its own settings on activation.

filesystem.description: Read/write local files scoped to the given paths. Defaults to $HOME on add — override with 'vinos-mcp add filesystem --path /some/dir'.

github.description: Read GitHub repos, issues, PRs, code search. Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in env.

fetch.description: Fetch arbitrary URLs and return sanitized content. No credentials required. Rate limits apply to remote hosts.

sequential-thinking.description: Structured multi-step reasoning primitive. Useful for chain-of-thought scaffolding when the model needs to plan before acting.

playwright.description: Headless browser automation via Playwright — navigate, click, extract, screenshot. Installs Chromium on first launch.

sqlite.description: Query and mutate a local SQLite database. Path defaults to ~/.local/share/vinos/mcp-sqlite/default.db; override on add.
